name: status-bar
description: Folds every plugin's status line into one line under the prompt, or one wrapped row above it

mode.title: Layout
mode.description: status: one status line under the prompt. band: one wrapped row above the prompt (terminal and desktop only).

maxSegment.title: Segment length
maxSegment.description: Each plugin's text is cut to this many cells with an ellipsis (8 to 200).

width.title: Line width
width.description: Terminal width to fit the status line to, used until a band draw reports the real width (40 to 1000).

order.title: Order
order.description: Comma-separated plugin names shown first; the rest follow alphabetically.

hide.title: Hidden
hide.description: Comma-separated plugin names whose statuses are dropped.
